messages.author: ce683b307e5b88d5
messages.subject: MSstatsPTM feature request DIA-NN input
parts:
Dear MSstats Team,

We are routinely using MSstats in our facility for statistical analysis and would also like to implement MSstatsPTM. Many of our DIA analyses are run via FragPipe DIA-NN or DIA-NN standalone.
In the current version of MSstatsPTM I cannot find a dedicated DIA-NN importer function. Is this something that is planned or which could be implemented? We would highly appreciate an adapter.

Kind Regards,
Klemens

messages.author: 13904eb0f06097b0
messages.subject: Re: MSstatsPTM feature request DIA-NN input
parts:
Hi Klemens,

We are actively working on the FragPipe converter. DIA-NN is planned but we do not currently have an example dataset which can be used to build the converter. If you have any publicly available PTM data from DIA-NN that would be very helpful in building the converter.

Best,
Devon
